test_status_command_reports_running_agen: test the /status command reports session ID, tokens, and agent running status without interrupting the agent
test_status_command_includes_session_tit: test the /status command includes session title when present in the session database
test_agents_command_reports_active_agent: test the /agents command reports active agents and running background processes from the process registry
test_tasks_alias_routes_to_agents: test the /tasks command alias routes to the /agents command and returns matching output
test_handle_message_persists_token_count: test the gateway runner persists agent token counts to the session store after message handling
test_handle_message_discards_stale_resul: test the gateway runner discards stale agent results after session invalidation
test_status_command_bypasses_session_gua: test the /status command bypasses active session guard and dispatches immediately without queuing
test_profile_command_reports_custom_root: test the /profile command reports custom root profile directory when HERMES_HOME is set
